editorial.description_en: A field a week before it is cut. The most yellow entry in the group, and bright without being a yellow.
editorial.description_ja: 刈る前の麦畑のような、あたたかい黄。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.838, C 0.062, h 84.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 麦 (mugi, wheat) + 畑 (hatake, field), rendaku to -batake. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Wheat Field" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 麦畑. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — suna-kabe at ΔE00 6.7, hi-kabe at ΔE00 7.2, kare-no at ΔE00 8.0. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (264°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
